{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check distribution of arm and severity
print('\nArm distribution:\n', df["arm"].value_counts())
print('\nSeverity distribution:\n', df["severity"].value_counts())
print('\nArm vs Severity cross-tab:\n', pd.crosstab(df["arm"], df["severity"]))"}
